notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
[h1]What's new in the update?[/h1]
Third level, we move into the depths of the city.  The mission gets harder, climb higher and collect bullets from the rooftops.  New goals, they have their own little secret. ːsteamthisː
___________________________________________________________
[h2]A few words from Pannl Inc team[/h2] 

Greetings, we are Pannl inc. team, developers of Cyberdunk Anime Edition. Since early access,we had to increase the development time, as your feedback / comments / streams (our favorite❤️) make game a better.  We are making adjustments, and would like to inform you that the final version of Cyberdunk Anime Edition is planned with 4 main and 2 additional levels and also it would contain a lot of features such as possiblity to choose character!

ːsteammockingː the version for VR will be released as a separate edition, and not DLC, as stated earlier. Thanks for your feedback!  If you want to become a part of the Cyberdunk and get to the main page, write us to stream on our storepage. ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.content:
Cyberdunk Anime Edition is updated, we read every comment you make, thanks for your input.  Based on your wishes and bug reports, the new version will add the following features.
  [b]What's the news:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improvement of the picture when enlarged

[*] Removed some of the locations and items through which you could go

[*] Fixed a bug with the appearance of enemies on the second level after the first death

[*] Added control tips

[*] Added a target to the current level on the enemy points panel

[*] New panel sizes at the end of levels

[*] Ability to turn down the sound at levels

[*] Added a plot and video inserts when passing the level

[*] New character on the second level

[*] Weapon easter eggs on the second level

[*] New skins for characters on both levels

[*] Improved game optimization
[/list]
